seo_description: Explore USA scholarships for international students in our 2026 catalog. Browse listings, refine filters, and confirm eligibility on official program pages.
intro: International students exploring the USA for 2026 often need clearer signals that a program welcomes global applicants. This curated view highlights listings where citizenship fields or program text mention international students, visas, or similar eligibility so you can find relevant awards faster. Browse filters alongside the list, then open each official page to confirm rules, documents, and deadlines before you invest time in an application that fits your status.
